Roxgold SiteLife.
Meals and bar: my QR, the menu, my voucher.
At the restaurant, check-in is often done
on a paper list.
At the bar, it is hard to know what you have bought,
and what is left on your voucher.
With Roxgold SiteLife, your QR, today's menu
and your cash voucher are on your phone.
From your home screen, tap the Meals tab,
at the bottom of the screen.
Your restaurant QR appears, in your name.
Show it at the restaurant entrance:
the team scans it to validate your meal.
Just below, today's menu:
breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Then the times of each meal.
For the bar, open More, then Bar.
At the top, this year's cash voucher:
what is left, out of the starting amount.
And the total of your purchases this month.
The bar menu shows every item,
with its price and availability.
Filter by category.
An out-of-stock item shows: Sold out.
Finally, My purchases: every purchase,
with its date, amount and payment method.
Your meal validated with one scan, the menu at a glance,
and a cash voucher that is always up to date.
Roxgold SiteLife.
Enjoy your meal!
